players.bio: Damián Ayude (born 14 April 1982) is an Argentine football manager, currently in charge of Barracas Central. Career Born in Buenos Aires, Ayude worked in the youth sides of Nueva Chicago, Chacarita Juniors and Argentinos Juniors before joining Nicolás Larcamón's staff at Venezuelan side Deportivo Anzoátegui in 2016, as his assistant.

Damián Alberto Martínez is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Atlético Tucumán in the Argentine Primera División. Career Club Martínez started his career with San Lorenzo in 2009, making his professional debut on 3 April in an Argentine Primera División match with Arsenal de Sarandí. That was one of nine appearances for San Lorenzo between 2009 and 2010.

Dardo Federico Miloc (born 16 October 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Barracas Central. Career Miloc had youth spells with Cambaceres and Gimnasia y Esgrima. It was with the latter that he made his professional debut with, it came on 5 July 2009 in an Argentine Primera División victory against Gimnasia y Esgrima (J).

Omar Fernando Tobio (born October 18, 1989) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Barracas Central. Club career Tobio made his debut for Vélez Sársfield on March 1, 2008. In 2009, he was part of the squad that won the Clausura tournament, though he did not play any games.
Gonzalo Maroni (born 18 March 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Boca Juniors.

Iván Tapia (born 23 November 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Barracas Central. He is the son of Claudio Tapia. Career Tapia started his career with Barracas Central.

Jhonatan Marcelo Candia Hernández (born 15 March 1995) is an Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Barracas Central. Professional career Candia made his professional debut with Liverpool Montevideo in a 1-1 Uruguayan Primera División tie with Central Español on 6 April 2013. International career Candia represented the Uruguay U20s in 2014.

Juan Ángel Espínola González (born 2 November 1994) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Argentine Primera División club Newell's Old Boys and the Paraguay national team. Club career Espínola was born in Ciudad del Este.

Kevin Jhon Jappert (born 25 February 2004) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Barracas Central on loan from Atlético Rafaela. Technical features He is a central defender. Career He grew up in the youth sector of Atlético Rafaela where he made his debut on May 29, 2022 in the Primera B Nacional match drawn 2-2 against Mitre (SdE).
Lucas Emanuel Gamba (born 24 June 1987) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Unión Santa Fe.

Marcelo Agustín Miño (born 21 August 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Barracas Central, on loan from Ferro Carril Oeste. Career Club Atlético Guatimozín and Arias Foot Ball Club were youth teams of Miño, prior to him signing with Vélez Sarsfield and subsequently Rosario Central.
Nicolás Blandi (born 13 January 1990) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a forward for Barracas Central.

Nicolás Agustín Demartini (born 4 November 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for who currently plays for the Barracas Central, on loan from Temperley. Club career Demartini started his career with Temperley.
Nicolas Orsini (born September 9, 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a striker for Platense, on loan from Boca Juniors.

Norberto Alejandro Briasco Balekian (Armenian: Նորբերտո Ալեխանդրո Բրիասկո Բալեկյան; born 29 February 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Argentine Primera División club Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata, on loan from Boca Juniors and the Armenia national team. Born in Argentina to an Armenian Argentine mother, he has represented Armenia internationally since 2018.
Rafael Victoriano Barrios (born 23 May 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Barracas Central.
Rodrigo Manuel Bogarín Giménez (born 24 May 1997) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a right midfielder for Mexican club Querétaro, on loan from Defensa y Justicia.

Rodrigo Axel Insúa (born 16 December 1997 in Buenos Aires) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder. He plays as a left-back and his current team is Barracas Central of the First Division. Career He emerged from Club Atlético Boca Juniors, until he was released in 2017 at the age of 20. Later he joined Aldosivi de Mar del Plata, where he played in the Reserve Division.
Sebastián Emanuel Moyano (born 26 August 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Barracas Central.

Tomás Uriel Porra (born 9 January 2004) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Barracas Central. Career He grew up in the youth sector of San Lorenzo, with whom he signed his first professional contract in August 2020.
Wilfredo Aramat Rivera Cepeda (born October 14, 2003) is a Puerto Rican professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Puerto Rico national team and MLS Next Pro club Orlando City B.
Yeison Stiven Gordillo Vargas (born 25 June 1992) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Vélez Sarsfield.
Yonatthan Nicolás Rak Barragán (born 18 August 1993) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Argentine Primera División club Barracas Central.
